caption: This is a black and white line drawing that depicts architectural elements of a building. The top half of the drawing shows a rectangular window divided into small square panes. Directly in front of the window is a decorative window grille made of wrought iron, which features a symmetrical pattern with a large central circular motif containing floral-like swirls and radiating lines, surrounded by smaller, repeated diamond and heart-shaped designs. Below the window and grille, there is a broad horizontal ledge or cornice, beneath which runs a series of parallel lines indicating masonry or architectural detailing. The bottom portion of the image displays a semi-circular arch constructed of three concentric bands, suggesting a stone structure. To the right of the arch, the words “WINDOW GRILLE. CABILDO” are inscribed in capital letters. The entire composition uses fine cross-hatching, stippling, and parallel lines to convey depth, texture, and shading, and is rendered in monochrome on a lightly aged or toned background.
title: Wrought Iron Balcony Rail
